text: Execute the "one prop = one file, uniform capability" prop refactor (reqs req_0846 req_0848 req_0849 req_0850 req_0852; also close out req_0841). Goal/end-state, no exceptions: (1) every prop is its own self-contained file in cart/hmsc-int/compile/propRecipes/, authored in ONE uniform builder format (box/cylinder8/cylinder16/sphere/panel/glassBox → PropPartSpec[]); drop the second declarative PropRecipe/types.ts format and rewrite the ~30 existing solo files to the builder form. (2) Every prop has the SAME full capability: image-as-texture on any part (partId via panel()), glass/opacity (glassBox), and a MEASURED physics footprint — make propModelFootprintMeters read the single resolver so it works for every prop, not just the old RECIPES kinds (move it to propRecipes/ to avoid an import cycle; update the 4 callers: pieceMeshes, placed, catalog, world/props). (3) Dissolve the propModels.ts RECIPES god-file (64 props) into one-file-per-prop; reduce propModels.ts to pure kit (types/builders/palette/hx). (4) One dispatch (resolve.ts registry of all kinds; remove the propModelParts fallback once empty). (5) Rename variant families by TYPE, never by a skinnable attribute like color — chairs (chair/chairRed/chairBlue/chairGreen → diningChair/armChair/computerChair/etc by type) are just ONE example; find and fix ALL such families (scan game/kinds/props.ts for color/skin-suffixed variant ids), renaming the kind id across the registry + every reference + any saved data in the SAME change. (6) Collapse existing double-definitions (chair lives in both chair.ts and RECIPES). (7) Fold streetSign into a recipe (add defaultTextureKey/texturedFaces to the format) and delete StreetSign.tsx. Work in green checkpoints: keep the build bundling, commit each coherent batch with explicit paths citing the req, never git add -A. When a sub-piece is fully done move its req to review with a real paragraph + shas. Each loop iteration: check git log for what prior iterations already landed, then continue the next batch.
